name: Bon Jon Pass TC

origin.basis: Rene Herse Cycles sells its tires from its own US web store in US dollars.

manufacturing.basis: Rene Herse product pages state the tires are made in Japan.

weight_basis: Rene Herse weight for the Standard casing; other casings in the size note.

availability.note: Sold by Rene Herse's US web store; other regions not verified.

positioning: 35 mm tubeless-compatible all-road tire for chip-seal pavement and smooth gravel.
hookless_note: Rene Herse recommends it for hookless and hooked rims with 17-27 mm inner width; 60 psi recommended tubeless.

sizes.note: Extralight 310 g; Endurance 365 g; 60 psi recommended tubeless

caveats: Mixed-surface tire for chip seal and smooth gravel.

price_observations.conditions: Official store range US$84-97 by casing on 2026-11-01; the lowest price is shown; one tire.

image.shown: 700C x 35 TC tan-wall Bon Jon Pass as pictured on Rene Herse's product page.
image.alt: Rene Herse Bon Jon Pass 700C x 35 TC tire with tan sidewalls and printed size

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.

checks.note: Extralight 35 mm test page, 9 comments, none first-hand about this tire
